version-get.description: Print the version every version line is at, one line each: the version of its release tag when HEAD carries one, else the next version followed by the build suffix. The putnami process that launched the command computes the versions from git. --output=json or jsonl prints one result envelope. A line --scope does not name exits 2.

scope.description: Report only this version line, by its scope path.

version-tag.description: Release one version line: prepend its changelog to the line's CHANGELOG.md, commit it, then create the annotated tag on that commit. Without --yes it writes nothing: it prints the release it proposes, and with --dry-run the changelog too. It exits 2 and writes nothing for several lines without --scope, a tagged HEAD, a dirty tree, an existing tag, an off-pattern tag or a run bound to another commit; it exits 1 for a dependency graph that could not be refreshed and for a failure of git. It prints text only.

scope.description: The version line to release, by its scope path (required when the workspace declares several).

push.description: Push the release commit and the tag to origin.

dry-run.description: Print the proposed tag and changelog, and write nothing.

yes.description: Skip the confirmation and create the release commit and tag.

compose-up.description: Start the selected workload and the transitive closure of its runsWith projects in one invocation, each as a serve run of putnami. Every process binds an ephemeral port and answers behind a local reverse proxy whose URL stays stable across restarts; dependency URLs travel through the clients config block and databases declared in infra/requirements.json are provisioned per composition. Dependencies run production-mode without watch; the target watches by default. Stops every owned process, proxy and database on exit; the next invocation reaps what an ungraceful death left behind. --output=json or jsonl prints the start and exit documents as result envelopes.

port.description: Proxy port of the target; default options.serve.port then 3000; 0 picks an ephemeral port.

watch.description: Watch the target; --no-watch runs it production-mode without watch, like its dependencies.

ready-timeout.description: Deadline for each member's typed ready event, as a Go duration; default 60s.

qualify-run.description: Derive the smoke contract from the workload's route inventory, execute it against --target (local composes the workload with compose; a URL is any deployed environment), and print one verdict bound to the tested tree or to the deployed sha. Fails closed: unsupported, not_run, timed_out, canceled, target_unreachable, digest_mismatch and composition_failed are distinct from passed and exit 1; an invalid invocation exits 2.

target.description: local composes the workload on this machine; an http(s) URL is a running deployment.

expect-sha.description: Required with a URL target: the git sha the deployment must report on /version.

platform-prefix.description: Prefix under which /readyz and /version are mounted; setting it makes local readiness poll <path>/readyz instead of waiting for the startup claim; default: where the route inventory declares both, else the root.

ready-timeout.description: Deadline for readiness, as a Go duration; default 60s.

request-timeout.description: Deadline per smoke request, as a Go duration; default 5s.

print-contract.description: Print the derived contract and exit without a target.
